_about: Hand-verified corrections layered over the mechanical extraction (scripts/extract_eligibility.py) AND over the Chroma metadata at RagService load time, so they take effect without a re-scrape/LLM run. Key = myScheme slug. Facet keys (occupation_target_group, residence, gender, age_min_male, ...) replace the extracted value; canonical_group marks schemes that are the same programme listed twice (shortlist dedupes by it); aliases are extra names (English / Hinglish / Devanagari) for whole-word name matching - the API's Hindi names are machine-translated garbage ('वर्धस्थ'), so aliases ARE the Devanagari matching path. Every entry carries a _reason. Keys starting with '_' at the top level are ignored.

ignvpyr._reason: IGNOAPS - the national old-age pension (60+). Twin of the state Vriddhjan pension for a citizen asking for 'budhapa pension'; the MT Hindi name 'वर्धस्थ' is unusable for matching.

mvspy._reason: State old-age pension (55 F / 58 M per the eligibility text). Twin of IGNOAPS for ranking purposes.

cmsmfops._reason: Same programme as slesvkspy (small & marginal farmers' old-age pension, 55 F / 58 M). The API gives 55 for every category row, the eligibility text says 58 for men.

slesvkspy._reason: Same programme as cmsmfops. Keyword table missed 'krishak' so the farmer tag was absent.

cmsasps._reason: Disability pension (40%+ disability, any age). Was tagged 'student' because the brief says 'scholarship' by mistake. Same programme as mvyspy (Vishesh Yogyajan Samman Pension).

mvyspy._reason: Same programme as cmsasps. 'senior_citizen' came only from the word 'pension' (age 1-100).

ignvpyrr._reason: IGNWPS - national widow pension (40+). Not old age. Twin of the state Ekal Nari pension for a widow asking for 'vidhwa pension'.

cmenspy._reason: Ekal Nari = widow / divorced / abandoned women 18+. 'senior_citizen' came only from the word 'pension'.

ps._reason: Palanhar - monthly support for orphans / children of widows, prisoners, HIV, leprosy patients. Twin of the Vishesh Yogyajan Palanhar variant.

saps._reason: Palanhar for children (0-18) of specially-abled parents - the differently_abled facet was missing because the name says 'Vishesh Yogyajan', not 'disab'.

mcsby._reason: Chiranjeevi health insurance - renamed Mukhyamantri Ayushman Arogya Yojana (maayr) in 2024; both listings describe the same 1 May 2021 universal health cover.

maayr._reason: Same programme as mcsby (renamed). Keyword table tagged farmer+labourer from the brief's list of eligible families; the cover is universal.

kt._reason: Khet Talai (farm pond subsidy) - same programme as the 'Farm Pond (Khet Talai) Nirman Karyakram' listing.

msyr._reason: Applicant is a registered NGO / voluntary organisation (3+ years old) - NOT an individual widow/woman. Tagging it widow/woman made it surface for widows asking for help.

sdvay._reason: Marriage grant for specially-abled (40%+) bride or groom - differently_abled was missing (name says 'Vishesh Yogyajan').

ssfsap._reason: Scholarship for specially-abled (40%+) students - differently_abled was missing (name says 'Vishesh Yogyajan').

lpy._reason: Eligibility text: 'a woman who is a native of Rajasthan' delivering a girl in a govt/JSY-authorised institution - no rural restriction.

msveay._reason: Mass-marriage grant for bride AND groom (18 F / 21 M, both unmarried) - not a women-only scheme.

mky._reason: Aliases only - the most-asked marriage scheme; 'kanyadan' never appeared in the English name's tokens before.

rksyr._reason: Aliases only - citizens say 'ration' / 'NFSA', never 'Khadya Suraksha'.

ky._reason: Aliases only - Devanagari name for the farm-equipment subsidy.

mwfhjwy._reason: Aliases only - a bare 'job'/'naukri' need must NOT name-match this scheme (it is a women's work-from-home scheme).

wwiip._reason: WWII veterans and their widows; 'senior_citizen' came only from 'pension' (age 18+).
